headline: CHC Limits Impact of Email Breach; Minor Shipping Delays Noted
body: Changzhou Horizon Connectors (CHC) disclosed a security breach involving its email systems, which affected order processing and delayed shipping alerts. The firm confirmed that no plant operations or encryption of critical infrastructure occurred. Authorities noted minor logistic setbacks, expecting prompt resolution to resume normal functions. Located in eastern China, CHC maintains that the issue was swiftly contained.
